mapper.select: select id, app_id, open_id_hash, user_id, cancel_time, allow_register_time, create_time, update_time from user_account_cancel_record where app_id = #{appId} and open_id_hash = #{openIdHash} and allow_register_time > #{now} order by allow_register_time desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_account_cancel_record ( app_id, open_id_hash, user_id, cancel_time, allow_register_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{appId}, #{openIdHash}, #{userId}, #{cancelTime}, #{allowRegisterTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) on duplicate key update user_id = values(user_id), cancel_time = values(cancel_time), allow_register_time = values(allow_register_time), update_time = values(update_time)
